newsitem.title: CANADA: T-D Bank sets Waterhouse shr ratio.
newsitem.headline: T-D Bank sets Waterhouse shr ratio.

text.p: Toronto-Dominion Bank said on Tuesday that it has set the share exchange ratio for its C$715 million acquisition of U.S. discount broker Waterhouse Investor Services Inc.
Waterhouse shareholders will receive 1.87046 shares of TD common stock for every Waterhouse share for a consideration equal to US$38 per Waterhouse share, the bank said in a statement.
All Waterhouse shareholders who do not elect to receive TD stock will be subject to proration and will receive two-thirds in cash and one-third in TD common stock.
The exact proration will be calculated at the closing of the deal scheduled for October 15, the bank said.
T-D Bank's acquisition of Waterhouse Investor Services received final approval from the U.S. Federal Reserve on Monday.
T-D Bank is Canada's fifth largest bank and operates the country's biggest discount broker, Greenline Investor Services Inc.
